author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
40 years in 40 seconds
40 years of iconic games, unforgettable player moments, and the talents behind them. Here's to the next chapter. 


In 1986, a journey began 🚀 

This year, we’re celebrating 40 years of creating games, and what a journey it’s been. From Rayman, Ubisoft’s first major success and a timeless fan favorite, to the birth of iconic franchises like Assassin’s Creed, Far Cry, Rainbow 6, Just Dance and many more, these four decades have been filled with unforgettable worlds and stories. 

To everyone who has been part of this adventure, players, creators, and team members: THANK YOU. Here’s to the next 40 🥂 

For this special occasion, follow Rayman as he travels through four decades of Ubisoft worlds 🌍, revisiting some of the iconic moments that shaped our history.  

Stay tuned for what’s coming next!
